<subject>Re: Tatjana Indication</subject>
<body>
Klaus-Günter,
If you were to look at it from a [Hamburg] wholesale power index basis, how would this look? I think he wants to float with an index price but wants some feel for what type of basis to [Hamburg] we would use. It's not really a firm bid since he is not really going to transact, so it's really an indication of the market. Kind of odd, but the better we make our price relative to [Hamburg], the more likely we can get the business. We should show him a strong bid subject to credit etc. When the time comes to actually lock it in, and most likely he will not since the wind farm has no historical performance, who knows what the market price will be.

Arno
</body>
<quoted>
-----Original Message-----
From: Paffrath, Klaus-Günter <klaus-guenter.paffrath@nordwind-energie.de>
Sent: Mittwoch, 18. Juni 2025 09:32
To: Hertrampf, Arno <arno.hertrampf@nordwind-energie.de>
Cc: Reising, Lorenzo <lorenzo.reising@nordwind-energie.de>; Johann, Fritz <fritz.johann@nordwind-energie.de>
Subject: Tatjana Indication

Arno, here are the quarterly indications for Tatjana that we discussed:

		Q3 2025			Q4 2025			Q1 2026			Q2 2026


HLH		115 €/MWh		68 €/MWh		52 €/MWh		50 €/MWh

LLH		55 €/MWh		39 €/MWh		31 €/MWh		29 €/MWh


The prices indicated are for firm power delivered with liquidated damages. Wind farm contingent products will be discounted 20%-30% on HLH and 10%-20% on LLH depending on term.
</quoted>
